The table lists all the [[mandal]]s in the [[List of districts in Telangana|33 districts]] of [[Telangana]].<ref name=census>{{cite web|title=Part-I State Administrative Divisions 2001–2011|url=http://www.censusindia.gov.in/2011census/maps/atlas/28part1.pdf|publisher=Census of India|accessdate=18 January 2015|page=4,8–18}}</ref> The state comprises 612 mandals.<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 2022 |title=Telangana State Statistical Abstract (ATLAS) 2022 |url=https://telangana.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Telangana-State-Statistical-Abstract-2022-1.pdf |access-date=24 October 2024 |website=Telangana state portal |publisher=Government of Telangana |pages=3 |language=English}}</ref>

Each mandal is administered by a ''mandal revenue officer'', and consists several revenue villages.
